verdict.rationale: Hightouch's official MCP server lets an AI assistant understand the customer schema and build audiences in plain language. Its documented example prompt creates a cart-abandoner audience. Separately, the built-in agent explores segments in natural language. Together these cover the core of NL-to-segment creation grounded in the workspace schema. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a draft/review step before the AI-built segment goes live, detail on how the generated definition maps to schema fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
